#install.packages("RSQLite")
library(DBI)     # Load DBI library 
library(RSQLite) # Load RSQLite library 

# Establishing connection to SQLite database
conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),"C:/Users/User/Documents/mental_health.sqlite")  # Connect to local SQLite database

dbListTables(conn) # List all tables in the database

# Querying the Survey table
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT * FROM Survey")  # Retrieve all rows from Survey table

# SELECT ALL FROM Question table
data0 <- dbGetQuery(conn,"SELECT * FROM Question")  # Load all questions

# SELECT first 3 questions from Question table
data1 = dbGetQuery(conn,"SELECT * FROM Question LIMIT 3")  # Limit to first 3 rows
print(data1)  # Print first 3 questions

# Querying the Answer table
data2=dbGetQuery(conn,"SELECT*FROM Answer") 
summary(data2)
summary(data2$AnswerText)  
str(data2)  # Structure of Answer table

# Convert AnswerText to numeric for age (assuming numeric answers)
data2$age<-as.numeric(data2$AnswerText)
str(data2)  # Check structure after conversion

?subset 

# Subsetting answers for specific questions
data2.1<-subset(data2,QuestionID==1)  # Answers for QuestionID 1
summary(data2.1$age)  # Summary of age column

data2.2<-subset(data2,QuestionID==2)  # Answers for QuestionID 2
names(data2.2)[1]<-"gender"  # Rename first column to 'gender'
str(data2.2)  # Check structure
table(data2.2$gender)  # Frequency table for gender

dbDisconnect(conn)  # Close the database connection


#install.packages("XML","xml2")
#install.packages("xml2")
library(XML) 
library(xml2) 

# Read XML data from URL
plant_xml<-read_xml('https://www.w3schools.com/xml/plant_catalog.xml')
str(plant_xml)  # Check XML structure

plant_xml_parse<-xmlParse(plant_xml)  # Parse XML into R structure
plant_xml_parse 
plant_nodes=getNodeSet(plant_xml_parse,"//PLANT")  # Extract all PLANT nodes
data3<-xmlToDataFrame(nodes=plant_nodes)  # Convert XML nodes to data frame
head(data3)  
str(data3)  # Check structure

# Cleaning price column
data3$price_clean <- gsub("\\$", "", data3$PRICE)  # Remove $ symbol
str(data3$price_clean)
data3$PRICE<- as.numeric(data3$price_clean)  # Convert to numeric
str(data3$Price_numeric)  # Check structure of numeric price

# WEB SCRAPING USING RVEST
#install.packages("rvest")
library(rvest)

# Read HTML page
table_web<-read_html('https://www.w3schools.com/html/html_tables.asp')
str(table_web)

table_web %>% html_nodes("table")  # Extract all table nodes
table_table<-table_web%>%html_table()%>%.[[1]]  # Extract first table as dataframe


url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Argentina_national_football_team"
file <- read_html(url)
tables <- html_nodes(file,"table")  # Extract all tables
tables  # Display list of tables

# Extract and preview tables 18-24
test1 <- html_table(tables[18]); head(test1)
test2 <- html_table(tables[19]); head(test2)
test3 <- html_table(tables[20]); head(test3)
test4 <- html_table(tables[21]); head(test4)
test5 <- html_table(tables[22]); head(test5)
test6 <- html_table(tables[23]); head(test6)

# Table 24 requires fixing first row as column names
test7 <- html_table(tables[24]); head(test7)
test7.df <- as.data.frame(test7)  # Convert to data frame
names(test7.df) <- paste(names(test7.df),test7.df[1,], sep = "_")  # Add first row values to column names
test7.df <- test7.df[-1,]  # Remove first row
head(test7.df)
str(test7.df)  # Check structure

# Extract other tables for preview
test8 <- html_table(tables[25]); head(test8)
test9 <- html_table(tables[30]); head(test9)
test9.df<-as.data.frame(test9)
summary(test9.df$D)  # Summary of column D

# COVID-19 TABLE SCRAPING FROM WIKIPEDIA
wiki_link <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_pandemic_in_Nepal"
wiki_page <- read_html(wiki_link)
str(wiki_page)

wiki_page %>% html_nodes("table")  # List all tables

# Extract table using div class
covid_table <- wiki_page %>%
  html_element("div.COVID-19_pandemic_data_Nepal_medical_cases") %>%
  html_nodes("table") %>% html_table() %>% .[[1]]  # Get first table
str(covid_table)

# Use first row as column names
names(covid_table) <- paste(names(covid_table),covid_table[1],sep="_")
covid_table <- covid_table[-1,]  # Remove first row
str(covid_table)

# Rename columns
colnames(covid_table) <- c("Date", "Confirmed_Cases_Total",
                           "Confirmed_Cases_New", "Confirmed_Cases_Active",
                           "Recoveries_Total","Recoveries_New","Deaths_Total",
                           "Deaths_New","PCR_Total","PCR_New","TPR","RR","CFR","Ref")

# Cleaning + symbols
covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_New <- gsub('[+]',"", covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_New)
covid_table$Recoveries_New <- gsub('[+]',"", covid_table$Recoveries_New)
covid_table$Deaths_New <- gsub('[+]',"", covid_table$Deaths_New)
covid_table$PCR_New <- gsub('[+]',"", covid_table$PCR_New)

# Cleaning % symbols
covid_table$TPR <- gsub('[%]', "", covid_table$TPR)
covid_table$RR <- gsub('[%]', "", covid_table$RR)
covid_table$CFR <- gsub('[%]', "", covid_table$CFR)

# Convert numeric columns
covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_Total <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_Total))
covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_New   <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_New))
covid_table$Recoveries_Total      <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", covid_table$Recoveries_Total))
covid_table$Recoveries_New        <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", covid_table$Recoveries_New))
covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_Active <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_Active))

# Print key columns to check
print(covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_Total)
print(covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_New)
print(covid_table$Recoveries_Total)
print(covid_table$Recoveries_New)
print(covid_table$Confirmed_Cases_Active)

# DATABASE OPERATIONS
library(DBI)
library(dbplyr)
#install.packages("dbplyr")
library(tidyverse)
#install.packages('tidyverse')
library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)

# In-memory SQLite connection
con<-dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(),":memory:")
dbListTables(con)  # List tables
dbWriteTable(con,"mtcars",mtcars)  # Write mtcars table
dbListTables(con)  # Check tables
dbListFields(con,"mtcars")  # List fields
dbReadTable(con,"mtcars")  # Read table

# Query with condition
res <- dbSendQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM mtcars WHERE cyl = 4")
dbFetch(res)  # Fetch query result
dbClearResult(res)  # Clear result from memory

dbDisconnect(con)  # Close connection

# DUCKDB DATABASE
#install.packages("duckdb")
con<-DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())  # Connect to DuckDB
#install.packages("ggplot2")
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(ggplot2)

# Write ggplot2 datasets to DuckDB
dbWriteTable(con,"mpg",ggplot2::mpg)
dbWriteTable(con,'diamonds',ggplot2::diamonds)
dbListTables(con)  # Check tables

library(dplyr)
con %>% dbReadTable("diamonds") %>% as_tibble()  # Read diamonds as tibble

# Diamond filtering
diamonds_db <- tbl(con,"diamonds")  # Connect to diamonds table
diamonds_db <- tbl(con,sql("SELECT*FROM diamonds"))
big_diamonds_db <- diamonds_db %>% filter(price>15000) %>% select(carat:clarity,price)
big_diamonds_db %>% show_query()  # Show SQL query
big_diamonds <- big_diamonds_db %>% collect()  # Fetch to R
big_diamonds  # Display result

# Tibbles examples
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
table1 <- tibble(
  country = c("Afgansthan", "Afgansthan", "Brazil", "Brazil", "China", "China"),
  year = c(1999, 2000, 1999, 2000, 1999, 2000),
  cases = c(745, 2666, 37737, 80488, 54325, 234523),
  population = c(54543, 4354, 3533, 35345, 435435435, 345345)
)
table1

table2 <- tibble(
  country=c("afgansthan","afgansthan","afgansthan","afgansthan","brazil","brazil"),
  type=c("cases","population","cases","population","cases","population"),
  yeartype=c(1999,1999,2000,2000,1999,1999),
  count=c(745,19987071,2666,20595360,37737,1720006362)
)
table2

library(tidyr)
# Convert long to wide
table2 %>% pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = count)

# Pivot longer example
table4a <- tibble(
  country=c("afgansthan","brazil","china"),
  '1999'=c(745,453,25),
  '2000'=c(35,524354,352435)
)
table4a %>% pivot_longer(cols = c('1999', '2000'), names_to = "year", values_to = "cases")

# Separate rate column
table3 <- tibble(
  country = c("Afghanistan","Afghanistan","Brazil","Brazil","China","China"),
  year = c(1999,2000,1999,2000,1999,2000),
  rate = c("745/199987071","2666/20595360","37737/172006362","80488/1745504898","212258/1272915272","213766/1280428583")
)
table3 %>% separate(rate, into = c("cases","population"))
table3 %>% separate(rate, into = c("cases","population"), sep = "/")

# Mean of stock returns ignoring NA
stocks <- tibble(
  year=c(2015,2015,2015,2015,2016,2016,2016),
  qtr=c(1,2,3,4,2,3,4),
  return=c(1.88,0.59,0.35,NA,0.92,0.17,2.66)
)
print(mean(stocks$return, na.rm=TRUE))

# Merge examples
authors <- data.frame(
  surname = c("Tukey", "Venables", "Tierney", "Ripley", "McNeil"),
  nationality = c("US", "Australia", "US", "UK", "Australia"),
  deceased = c("yes", rep("no", 4))
)
authorN <- within(authors, { name <- surname; rm(surname) })  # Rename column for merge
print(authorN)

books <- data.frame(
  name = c("Tukey", "Venables", "Tierney","Ripley", "Ripley", "McNeil", "R Core"),
  title = c("Exploratory Data Analysis","Modern Applied Statistics ...","LISP-STAT","Spatial Statistics", "Stochastic Simulation","Interactive Data Analysis","An Introduction to R"),
  other.author = c(NA, "Ripley", NA, NA, NA, NA,"Venables & Smith")
)
print(books)

# Merge examples
(m0 <- merge(authorN, books))
(m1 <- merge(authors, books, by.x = "surname", by.y = "name"))
m2 <- merge(books, authors, by.x = "name", by.y = "surname")
(m3 <- merge(authors, books, by.x = "surname", by.y = "name", all=TRUE))
stopifnot(exprs = {
  identical(m0, m2[, names(m0)])
  as.character(m1[, 1]) == as.character(m2[, 1])
  all.equal(m1[, -1], m2[, -1][ names(m1)[-1] ])
  identical(dim(merge(m1, m2, by = NULL)), c(nrow(m1)*nrow(m2), ncol(m1)+ncol(m2)))
})
merge(authors, books, by.x = "surname", by.y = "name", all = TRUE)

# More merge examples
x <- data.frame(k1 = c(NA,NA,3,4,5), k2 = c(1,NA,NA,4,5), data = 1:5)
y <- data.frame(k1 = c(NA,2,NA,4,5), k2 = c(NA,NA,3,4,5), data = 1:5)
merge(x, y, by = c("k1","k2"))
merge(x, y, by = "k1")
merge(x, y, by = "k2", incomparables = NA)

# DPLYR joins
tibble1 <- tibble(id=c(1,2,3), name=c("Alice","Bob","Charlie"))
tibble2 <- tibble(id=c(1,2,3), age=c(25,30,35))
tibble3 <- tibble(id=c(1,3,2), sex=c("F","F","M"))
merged_tibble <- left_join(tibble1,tibble2,tibble3,by="id")
print(merged_tibble)

# NYCFLIGHTS13
library(nycflights13)
library(dplyr)

jan1 <- flights %>% filter(month == 1, day == 1) %>% collect()
summary(jan1$dep_delay)  # Summary statistics

# Reference ranges for dep_delay
dep.delay.mean <- mean(jan1$dep_delay, na.rm = T)
dep.delay.sd <- sd(jan1$dep_delay, na.rm = T)
dep.delay.LL <- dep.delay.mean - 1.96*dep.delay.sd
dep.delay.UL <- dep.delay.mean + 1.96*dep.delay.sd
ref.range <- c(dep.delay.LL, dep.delay.UL)
print(ref.range)

dep.delay.LL1 <- quantile(jan1$dep_delay,0.025,na.rm = T)
dep.delay.UL1 <- quantile(jan1$dep_delay,0.975,na.rm = T)
ref.range.1 <- c(dep.delay.LL1, dep.delay.UL1)

# Outlier detection
outliers <- which(jan1$dep_delay < dep.delay.LL | jan1$dep_delay > dep.delay.UL)
outliers <- which(jan1$dep_delay < dep.delay.LL1 | jan1$dep_delay > dep.delay.UL1)

# Histograms and QQ plots
hist(jan1$dep_delay)
abline(v=dep.delay.LL)
abline(v=dep.delay.UL)
qqnorm(jan1$dep_delay)
qqline(jan1$dep_delay)

# Log transform with finite values
log.dep.delay <- log(jan1$dep_delay[jan1$dep_delay>0])  # Avoid -Inf
hist(log.dep.delay)
qqnorm(log.dep.delay)
qqline(log.dep.delay)

boxplot(jan1$dep_delay)

dep.delay.Q1 <- quantile(jan1$dep_delay,0.25,na.rm=T)
dep.delay.Q2 <- quantile(jan1$dep_delay,0.75,na.rm=T)
dep.delay.IQR <- IQR(jan1$dep_delay,na.rm=T)

sum(jan1$dep_delay > 30, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filtering examples
nov_dec <- filter(flights, month %in% c(11,12))
filter(flights, !(arr_delay>120 | dep_delay>120))
sum(jan1$arr_delay >= 120, na.rm=TRUE)

arrange(flights, year, month, day)
arrange(flights, desc(dep_delay))

select(flights, time_hour, air_time, everything())
select(flights, contains('TIME'))

# Flights small example with new columns
flights_sml <- flights %>% 
  select(year:day, ends_with("delay"), distance, air_time) %>% 
  mutate(
    gain = dep_delay - arr_delay,  # Calculate gain
    speed = distance / air_time * 60  # Speed in miles/hour
  )
flights_sml %>% arrange(desc(speed))

flights %>% 
  select(year:day, ends_with("delay"), distance, air_time, tailnum) %>%
  mutate(speed = distance / air_time * 60) %>%
  arrange(desc(speed))

# Summarize dep_delay
summarise(flights, delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm=TRUE))

# Grouping examples
by_day <- group_by(flights, year, month, day)
summarise(flights, delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm=TRUE))
by_day <- group_by(flights, carrier)
summarise(flights, delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm=TRUE))

by_dest <- group_by(flights, dest)
delay <- summarise(
  by_dest,
  count = n(),  # Count of flights
  dist = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE),  # Average distance
  delay = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE)  # Average arrival delay
)

head(delay)
